# luge-desktop-download

The public **download + auto-update site** for Luge, served via GitHub Pages at
<https://luge-works.github.io/luge-desktop-download/>. Everything here is
**generated by the release pipelines** — don't hand-edit `index.html`.

## What's served

| File / dir | What |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The download page — two tabs: **Desktop** (installers) + **Edge** (the standalone CLI). Generated by `build_download_page.py`. |
| `latest.json` | The **desktop** Tauri updater manifest (version + per-platform signed URLs). The desktop app polls it for in-app updates. |
| `releases/` | Desktop installers (`.dmg` / `.exe` / `.msi` / `.deb` / `.rpm`) + updater artifacts (`.app.tar.gz`, `.sig`). |
| `releases/edge/` | Edge CLI archives (`luge-edge-<ver>-<target>.tar.gz` / `.zip`). |
| `luge-logo.png` | The page logo. |
| `build_download_page.py` | The page generator — **shared** by the desktop and edge deploys. |
| `.nojekyll` | Tells GitHub Pages not to run Jekyll over the site. |

## How it's updated

On a release tag, the product's release workflow:

1. builds + signs the artifacts and attaches them to a (private) GitHub release;
2. **deploy step** — clones this repo, replaces its product's archives under
   `releases/` (desktop) or `releases/edge/` (edge) with the new release —
   **keeping only the latest version** (each deploy wipes its own subdir first,
   leaving the other product's untouched) — rewrites `latest.json` URLs to point
   at Pages, regenerates `index.html`, then **force-pushes a single orphan commit**.

- Desktop: `luge-works/luge-desktop` → `.github/workflows/release.yml` (`deploy-website` job).
- Edge: `luge-works/luge-edge` → `.github/workflows/release.yml` (deploy step → `releases/edge/`).

> ### History is intentionally a single commit
> This is a *generated mirror*. Keeping every past release's installers (~200 MB
> each: `.deb` + `.rpm`) in git history bloated the repo past **1 GB**, so each
> deploy resets `main` to a fresh orphan commit. **Don't expect git history**, and
> a deploy must always **clone first** so it preserves the other product's assets
> + manifest before force-pushing.

## Regenerate the page locally

```sh
python3 build_download_page.py <desktop_version> releases index.html
```

Desktop installers come from `releases/`; the **Edge** tab renders from
`releases/edge/` (or shows "coming soon" when empty). The 3-arg desktop call is
unchanged — the edge tab is additive.

## Updater manifests

- **Desktop** — `latest.json` (Tauri updater). Its endpoint is baked into the app.
- **Edge** — `edge-latest.json` (`version` + `pub_date` +
  `platforms{ url, sha256 }`), read by `luge-edge update`. Kept separate so the
  two products update independently.
